propositions: Cumulative counter streams in observability.sh advance their offset before CloudWatch put-metric-data succeeds, causing transient publish failures to permanently lose the interval's delta on the next run.

All seven affected metric streams (replication, voter, merge-change, deploy, shared deferral/interrupt helper, and two G2P metrics) exhibit the same defect pattern: offset persisted before AWS call, zero published on retry after failure.

Reordering each stream to advance offset only after successful CloudWatch publication will preserve the failed count for retry and restore the original contract that observed failures publish metrics and trip alarms.

Failed CloudWatch publication must leave the offset byte-identical and unacknowledged, while the script exits zero and remains compatible with systemd/autodeploy callers and reset/zero-delta semantics.
